  {
    "testCaseID": "TC_POS_001",
    "title": "Validate Successful LTE Attach and Detach of Single UE under Excellent Radio Conditions",
    "description": "Verify that a single UE can successfully perform LTE attach and detach procedures 10 consecutive times under excellent radio conditions with 100% success rate and measure attach latency.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Test setup is a single isolated LTE cell with no inter-cell interference.",
      "UE (real or emulated) is placed at cell center with LTE RSRP meeting excellent radio condition criteria (Clause 4.6).",
      "All other cells are powered off.",
      "Test configuration parameters are recorded."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Access the 5G CLI interface using `SSH admin@<IP>` and authenticate.",
      "Configure the test setup as per test configuration parameters (single cell, LTE).",
      "Ensure the serving LTE cell is activated and unloaded.",
      "Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.",
      "For iteration 1 to 10:",
      "  'Power ON' the UE and wait for successful attach (validate attach request and attach complete messages).",
      "  Measure and record the attach latency from attach request to attach complete.",
      "  Verify UE is attached to the correct LTE cell (e.g., PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN).",
      "  'Power OFF' the UE and wait for successful detach (validate detach request and detach accept messages and signaling connection release).",
      "Stop logging and save logs for analysis.",
      "Calculate attach success rate, detach success rate (expected 100%), and attach latency statistics (min, average, max)."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach and detach procedures succeed 10 times consecutively with 100% success rate.",
      "Attach latency values are recorded and fall within expected performance boundaries.",
      "Logs confirm correct signaling flows and UE attachment to the configured LTE cell."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "UE remains detached after last iteration.",
      "Test logs are archived for reference."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "SSH admin@<IP>"
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Analyze UE logs and signaling messages for attach and detach success.",
      "Check KPI tables (Table 5-2 and Table 5-3) for recorded data.",
      "Validate RSRP measurements for radio conditions."
    ],
    "category": "POSITIVE TESTING"
  },

    "description": "Verify that a single UE can successfully perform 5G NSA attach and detach procedures including Secondary Node addition and release 10 consecutive times under excellent radio conditions with 100% success rate and measure attach latency.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Test setup is a single isolated cell supporting 5G NSA with no inter-cell interference.",

    "testSteps": [
      "Access the 5G CLI interface using `SSH admin@<IP>` and authenticate.",

      "Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.",
      "For iteration 1 to 10:",
      "  'Power ON' the UE and wait for successful attach to LTE cell (attach request and attach complete).",
      "  Validate Secondary Node Addition by verifying SgNB addition request and SgNB reconfiguration complete as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1.",

      "  Measure and record attach latency from attach request to attach complete.",
      "  'Power OFF' the UE and wait for successful detach from LTE cell and Secondary Node Release from NR cell (detach request and detach accept, UE context release, RRC connection release messages).",
      "Stop logging and save logs for analysis.",
      "Calculate attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, and detach success rate (expected 100%)."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach, secondary node addition, and detach procedures succeed 10 times consecutively with 100% success rate.",
      "Attach latency values are recorded and fall within expected performance boundaries.",
      "Logs confirm correct signaling flows for attach, secondary node addition, and detach."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "UE remains detached after last iteration.",
      "Test logs are archived for reference."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "SSH admin@<IP>"
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Analyze UE logs and signaling messages for attach, secondary node addition, and detach success.",
      "Check KPI tables (Table 5-2 and Table 5-3) for recorded data.",
      "Validate 5G SS-RSRP measurements for radio conditions."
    ],
    "category": "POSITIVE TESTING"
  },
